nodes.label: SEffectManager
nodes.rationale: One-shot effects require autodestroy and entity loops require explicit stop, preventing retained registry entries.

nodes.label: ScriptInvoker
nodes.rationale: Pair Insert with Remove and document callback signatures; teardown order requires null checks.

nodes.label: ParticleManager
nodes.rationale: Pool owns ParticleSource lifetime; render effects on clients and clean high-level SEffectManager registrations.

nodes.label: LNT_RPC
nodes.rationale: Namespace plus function name separates routes within the router; handlers register early and validate authority server-side.

nodes.label: LNT_ModuleManager
nodes.rationale: Typed server and client modules avoid double update dispatch on listen servers; centralized cleanup bounds mission state.

nodes.label: LNT_AutoConfigPlugin
nodes.rationale: Module lifecycle rules forbid config loading in OnInit, while the same chapter self-loading plugin example performs it there. Startup policy needs reconciliation.

nodes.label: Widget Pooling
nodes.rationale: Reuse rows and debounce searches to avoid repeated widget allocation during UI refresh.

nodes.label: ChatInputMenu
nodes.rationale: Intercept completed slash-command input before vanilla ChatPlayer broadcast; route authoritative execution to server.

nodes.label: CfgRecipes
nodes.rationale: Custom item tutorial suggests CfgRecipes config registration; the dedicated crafting chapter specifies RecipeBase subclasses and RegisterRecipies. Treat this tutorial suggestion as unresolved.
